QuestInfo.name: [Sellas] More Debris Beneath the Sea
QuestInfo.0: There's a promising pile of debris. If you search it, you might find what you need. Talk to Ollie.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat about 100 #b#o8642103:##k monsters to keep them off Ollie's back while she searches the debris.

mob.0: Defeating another 100 #b#o8642103:##k monsters should help make things better.
